package assignments;

public class Program1_PrintEmpDetails {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
		/*Q1 Create a Java program to store and print the following employee details:
		 * 	•	Employee ID
			•	Age
			•	Salary
			•	Department Initial
			•	Whether the employee is permanent

		 */
		
		int EmployeeID=1001;
		int Age=28;
		double Salary=55000.50;
		char Department='T';
		boolean Permanent=true;
		
		//To print all the required details
		System.out.println("Employee Id: "+EmployeeID);
		System.out.println("Age: "+Age);
		System.out.println("Salary: "+Salary);
		System.out.println("Department: "+Department);
		System.out.println("Permanent: "+Permanent);

	
	}

}
